Get started now
with coaching

Mary's process meets you where you are. Together, you identify the right focus, build a plan around your life, and create a rhythm of insight, action, and accountability.

The Mary McNutt coaching process

Step 1

Start with your story

A free, confidential consultation begins with your goals, challenges, and vision. Mary listens for the experiences, patterns, and strengths that have shaped where you are now.

  • Clarify what brings you to coaching
  • Discuss the change you want to make
  • Decide whether Mary's approach is a fit
Request a consultation
Step 2

Define what is “just right”

Mary helps you move beneath surface goals to the values, purpose, and direction that make change personally meaningful. The result is a clearer internal compass for decisions.

  • Explore your narrative and core values
  • Identify strengths, aptitudes, and priorities
  • Name a focused direction for the work
Meet Mary's approach
Step 3

Choose your coaching focus

Your work may center on one area or connect several parts of life. Mary brings an integrated perspective to personal, professional, family, and recovery-focused growth.

Transformational life coachingPurpose, confidence, clarity, and life alignment.Business & personal developmentProfessional growth, leadership challenges, and career transitions.Recovery & aftercareRelapse prevention, stability, accountability, and sustainable recovery.Family & emotional healingFamily patterns, relationships, grief, and life transitions.
Step 4

Create your personal plan

Coaching can combine one-to-one conversations, targeted learning, reflection, and practical “excavation” work between sessions. The structure is tailored to your goals and level of support.

  • A personalized growth and action plan
  • Regular sessions for insight and guidance
  • Practical work that connects learning to life
Compare ways to work together
Step 5

Sustain meaningful change

Transformation is more than a breakthrough moment. Ongoing reflection, accountability, and adjustments help turn new understanding into durable choices, healthier patterns, and forward movement.

  • Review progress with honesty
  • Adjust the plan as circumstances change
  • Build confidence in your own next steps
Begin the conversation
